verseText: And he said to him, 'You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind. This is the great and first commandment. And a second is like it: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'
meaning: The two most important commands in the Bible are both about love: to love God with all we have and to love people, treating them like we want to be treated.
